Name: Better Movement And Combat
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b]Better Movement and Combat[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4]Cursor facing aim, Auto weapon swing, Free movement, Extended reach, Smart tool swap.[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49065/49065-1786039439-528806997.png[/img][/center]
[line]
[center][color=#8e7cc3][b][size=6]Features[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][color=#b4a7d6][b][size=4]Mod Showcase Video[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][b][size=4][youtube]6pi83EaVSmA[/youtube][/size][/b][/center]
[color=#b4a7d6][b][size=4]Auto Swing[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Hold attack to repeat swings for swords, clubs, daggers, and scythes. [color=#b4a7d6](per-weapon-type toggle)[/color][/*]
[*]Faces cursor direction before each swing, can switch directions while attacking.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Movement[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Move while using weapons, tools, and slingshot. [color=#b4a7d6](includes special attacks)[/color][/*]
[*]Configurable movement speed multiplier while using items.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][b][size=4]Extended Reach[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Configurable total tool range reach.[/*]
[*]Can target tiles beneath the player.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][b][size=4]Smart Swap[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Auto-equip the right tool when clicking objects. [color=#b4a7d6](Keeps the equipped tool if it matches)[/color][/*]
[*]Detection modes: [color=#b4a7d6]Cursor [/color](tile under mouse) or [color=#b4a7d6]Player [/color](tile in front of player)[/*]
[*]Toggle key with in-game on/off notification. [color=#b4a7d6](default Z)[/color] [/*]
[*]When several tools match, equips the best one [color=#b4a7d6](highest upgrade level for tools, strongest weapon)[/color].[/*]
[*]Breaking stone or wood beats attacking a nearby monster: static targets are checked first and keep the matching tool equipped; a monster otherwise swaps in the weapon within 2 tiles of the cursor.[/*]
[*]Gamepad: targets the tile in front of the player, matching where the game aims.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][b][size=4]Smart Swap Toggles[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Axe[/b] - trees, stumps, logs, twigs, bushes. Option to skip saplings.[/*]
[*][b]Pickaxe[/b] - stone, ore, boulders, modded nodes (Lumisteria), custom boulders (ItemExtensions).[/*]
[*][b]Hoe[/b] - artifact spots, diggable soil.[/*]
[*][b]Watering Can[/b] - unwatered crops, pet bowl.[/*]
[*][b]Scythe[/b] - weeds, grass, moss on trees; sword-as-scythe option lets swords handle these instead.[/*]
[*][b]Weapon[/b] - monsters, crates, barrels; skips stone and ore so you don't swing at rocks.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Crabs[/b] - pickaxe only when a crab is in rock form; walking crabs get the weapon, shell on or off.[/*]
[*][b]Animals[/b] - milk pail, shears, hay for feeding bench.[/*]
[/list][line]
[center][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][/center]

[center][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]ItemExtensions[/url][/size][/b][/center]
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration. Without it, edit the config.json file directly.
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
